Retro Arcade

ColdSnap Arcade

Real games for old consoles, playable from any browser and competing on one leaderboard. The first one, David contre les zombies, is a survival game written in C for the Sega Master System. It runs on the original console from a flash cartridge, and here from the very same ROM.

Features

  • Runs the real ROM in the browser, the same file as on the console
  • One leaderboard for every game, on every console
  • Keyboard, controller and touch controls
  • Master System and Super Nintendo score reading tested, more consoles to come

Technologies

C Z80 SDCC EmulatorJS Cloudflare Workers Cloudflare D1
